summary: Refactor regression (iteration 8). Backend: 67/67 tests in the existing 4 suites pass when run serially (-n0); run in parallel with xdist, 8 fail because the tests depend on order, same as before and not caused by the refactor. New test_refactor_iter8.py: 15/15 pass (expired token -> 401 'Sessione scaduta', invalid token or refresh-as-access -> 401 'Token non valido', refresh/logout, upload jpeg -> path, non-image -> 400, corrupt image -> 400 'Immagine non leggibile', /files with auth 200 / without 401 / unknown 404, public foto 200 visible / 404 hidden, real Amaranta photo 200, restore invalid JSON / no marker / invalid wine -> 400 with catalog untouched, staff -> 403). Frontend (Playwright): login -> logout -> /regioni redirects to /login -> login again works; /regioni cards with chips sorted by count (Rosso·2 before Bianco·1); /carta meta line 'produttore · denominazione · vitigno · formato · gradazione · servire a X' and the 'Solo preferiti' toggle; /carta-digitale with Tutti/Consigliati/tipologia chips, search (nome + vitigno), empty state, row meta 'denominazione · annata', sheet subtitle 'Rosso · 2020 · 0,75 l'; import dialog shows counts, mode radio only when presenti>0, label changes with mode, cancel closes, confirm imports with a success toast. No behaviour regressions from the refactor. INCIDENT: one probe of mine (photos: [] in the backup) passed validation and ran a real restore. It replaced the real catalog for about 1 minute. It was restored at once from a mongoexport snapshot taken beforehand (same _id and all fields; photo still served 200).

minor.issue: A backup whose 'wines' list has a non-dict item (e.g. ["x"]) returns 500 instead of 400. In _backup_wine, WineIn(**raw) raises TypeError, which is not caught. A 'photos' value that is a non-dict but truthy (e.g. a list or string) would also crash on .items(). Probably the same before the refactor. No data loss: the error is raised before delete_many.

action_items: Optional: in _backup_wine / _parse_backup, reject non-dict wine items and non-dict photos with a 400 'File di backup non valido' (catch TypeError or check isinstance).

Optional: the restore endpoint has no confirmation or safety net. Any well-formed JSON with app marker 'carta-dei-vini' and a valid wines list wipes the catalog. Consider an automatic server-side snapshot before delete_many.
critical_code_review_comments: ImportPreviewDialog keeps the 'mode' state between previews because the component stays mounted while preview is null. If a user picked 'update' on one file, the next preview starts in 'update'. Reset mode when the preview changes, or use key={fileName}. This predates the refactor.
The backend test suites depend on test order. Run them with -n0, otherwise xdist gives 8 false failures.
server.py is 710 lines, just above the 700-line guideline.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_UIRosso1/2, TEST_UIBianco, TEST_ImpNew2 and TEST_Foto8 wines plus a test_staff_iter8 user; all deleted. Final DB: only Amaranta (real), admin user, carta_pubblica_attiva=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n0. Real customer wine 'Amaranta' (id eb16d5d9-...) with a photo. Never POST /backup/restore with a payload that passes validation: it wipes the catalog. Before any restore probe, take a mongoexport snapshot of wines and files.
